THESE PETITIONS, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -6-  NC: 2025:KHC:44098  WP No. 28959 of 2023  C/W WP No. 28769 of 2023 HC-KAR CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER 1.
The petitioner in W.P.No.28959/2023 and respondent No.2/complainant are husband and wife.
The petitioners in W.P.No.28769/2023 are the relatives of the husband.
There was a matrimonial dispute between the husband and wife, resulting in offences being alleged against the husband and his relatives.
It resulted in filing of an FIR initially by way of Crime No.339/2022 on the file of the XXXVIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore.
Aggrieved by the same, the husband and his relatives have preferred the aforementioned writ petitions with a prayer to quash the proceedings initiated pursuant to the FIR.

In the meanwhile, after investigation, a police report has been submitted to the Court, wherein the petitioners have been charged for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 354, 500, 504 and 506 of the IPC, 1860 along with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
NC: 2025:KHC:44098 HC-KAR 2.

It is now submitted by both the petitioners and the complainant counsel that the husband and wife have resolved their disputes amicably, and have decided to continue their relationship as husband and wife, and in the interest of both the parties, they together pray that the petitions be allowed as prayed for, and the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners be quashed.

3. It is seen that the criminal proceedings are pursuant to the matrimonial dispute between the husband and wife, and no heinous offences are alleged against the petitioners.

Under the circumstances, in order to facilitate peaceful and harmonious living of the petitioners as well as the complainant, the interest of justice requires that the criminal proceedings against the husband and his relatives are to be quashed.
4. The learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1 has no objection for the same.

5. Hence the following:-
NC: 2025:KHC:44098 HC-KAR ORDER i.
The petitions are allowed.
ii. The proceedings initiated pursuant to the FIR in Crime No.339/2022 by respondent No.1-police insofar as it relates to the petitioners are concerned stand quashed.

iii. Consequently, proceedings in C.C.No.4141/2024 pending on the file of XXXVII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Nrupatunga Road, Bengaluru,
insofar as it relates to the petitioners are concerned stand quashed.
